title: Polydactyly in the earliest known tetrapod limbs

authors: Pierce, S.E.; Clack, J.A.; Hutchinson, J.R.

title: The oldest articulated osteichthyan reveals mosaic gnathostome characters
authors: Zhu, M.; Zhao, W.; Jia, L.; Lu, J.; Qiao, T.; Qu, Q.
note: Primary description of articulated Ludlow sarcopterygian Guiyu oneiros; the paper also distinguishes the fossil occurrence from the inferred minimum actinopterygian–sarcopterygian split.

title: Support for Lungfish as the Closest Relative of Tetrapods by Using Slowly Evolving Ray-Finned Fish as the Outgroup
note: Tests the living coelacanth/lungfish/tetrapod relationship and outgroup effects; not the fossil range of Coelacanthimorpha.

title: Gnathostome Phylogenomics Utilizing Lungfish EST Sequences
note: An EST-based extant relationship analysis; it does not define the lungfish fossil range or origin.

title: The emergence of early tetrapods
note: A synthesis of sampled Devonian tetrapods and relatives; it does not identify a direct ancestor or exact clade birth.

title: A Marine Stem-Tetrapod from the Devonian of Western North America
note: A named fossil and matrix placement within a historical stem-grade route, not a direct ancestor or grade-wide FAD.
